title: Quotient-system realization and scalar Hom model of a normalized tower
statement:
theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_system_model
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl) :
    ∃ (Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ)
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, T.M n ≅
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj (coefTraceInput l E X Q)),
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        T.tau h ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).map (a n).hom =
          (a m).hom ≫ (coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E X h).app
            (coefTraceInput l E X Q)) ∧
      ∀ S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X,
        Nonempty (integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ≅
          (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι.op ⋙ coefPairingHom l E X S Q)

source.place: Second proof paragraph: finite mapping-complex comparisons and reduction-compatible counits.

proof.text: Apply normalizedDVR_quotient_system_realization to obtain Q, its compatible finite isomorphisms a, and the completed-coefficient strict tower isomorphism b.

Transport b through the inverse constant-sequence equivalence on derived categories, then through the covariant second argument of the curried constant-ring derived internal Hom. Whisker with derived constant input and derived sections. This gives a natural isomorphism d on the entire input derived category.

For each S compose d with coefHom_scalar_naturality for Q and S, and restrict by the opposite constructible inclusion. Keep a and its coherence from the first step. This proves the unchanged statement.
